violations.description: Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Ensure logs are filled out for roller grill item disposal times.--Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Cold fried chicken in refrigerator is not date marked. -Several items in bottom of make table are not date marked.--Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. -Taco meat in bottom of make table has prep date of 9/22.

Contaminated food disposition. — --Potentially hazardous food held for greater than four hours between 41F and 140F was not discarded when conditions required. -Hamburgers in warmer were found at 2:30 were timestamped for disposal at 1:44 and 2:10. *Corrected on-site, disposed of.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Residue in bottom water well of warmer. -Dipping Dots freezer has frost build up at interior surfaces. -Debris build up below beverage line around trash cans.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. -Dirty cloths left in hand sink basin.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. -Employee beverage left on utility cart used for fried chicken prep.
Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. -Mop left in bucket of shallow water.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -No date mark on wrapped breakfast sandwiches in walk in cooler.--Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. -Tornadoes in bottom of make table have discard dates of 11/25. -Breakfast pasties in walk in cooler have discard date of 12/2. -Dakota Tom sandwich had expire date of 12/2.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Heavy residue build up on pizza cooking trays.--Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Black debris at ice chute edges.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Residue at side of cut table below utensils/pizza paddles. -Limescale residue build up in water well bottom of warmer. -Crumb debris in bottom of sauce refrigerator. -Food spill/residue at bottom shelf of small prep table next to make table. -Residue at make table door fronts. -Residue in hand sink basin.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -Sleeves of pizza flats stored leaning on floor in pizza prep area and on floor near back door.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc. …) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Dust/debris at walk in cooler fans. -Floor debris build up below shelving in walk in cooler and walk in freezer. -Debris at floor in cabinet below customer beverage line.
